# API pricing
The API package is available as a standalone product — no active SE Ranking subscription is required. Start with a 14-day trial that includes **100,000 free API credits**.
Paid plans include monthly Data API credits for testing: **Core** (25,000/month), **Growth & Enterprise** (100,000/month).
**Legacy v7 plans:** Essential (10,000/month), Pro (25,000/month), Business & Enterprise (100,000/month).

Credits are required to make API calls. Each request deducts a set number of credits, either for the request itself or for each record returned. Credits are renewed monthly.
What happens if I go over my monthly credit limit? ⌄
By default, API access is blocked once your credit limit is reached. You will receive the following error message:
*"Insufficient funds. API key is temporarily disabled. Please make a payment to enable your API key, or contact us at [api@seranking.com](mailto:api@seranking.com)."*
If overage is enabled, API access continues and usage is billed at the end of the billing cycle.

Do you offer custom or enterprise plans? ⌄
Yes. For plans over 500 million credits, custom options are available:
- Adjustable rate limits (RPS)
- Account manager and solution architect assistance
- SLA agreements
[Schedule a call with our team](https://meetings.hubspot.com/alex-trusevich/data-product-api-demo) to discuss a plan that fits your use case.

title: Getting API access - SE Ranking API Documentation
snippet:
- **Data API:** Designed for pulling large volumes of raw SEO and marketing data (e.g., AI Search, keywords, backlinks, domain data). It uses a flexible, pay-as-you-go credit system.
- **Project API:** Designed for automating and managing your SEO projects (e.g., creating sites, managing keywords, running audits). Access is tied to your main subscription limits.

All Essential, Pro, Business, Core, Growth, and Enterprise plans include Data API access with a monthly credit allowance:
| Plan | Included API credits (per month) |
|---|---|
| Essential | 10,000 |
| Pro | 25,000 |
| Core | 25,000 |
| Business | 100,000 |
| Growth | 100,000 |
| Enterprise | 100,000 |
### Need more credits?
If your monthly allowance runs out or you need more volume, you can add credits in any of these ways. Add-ons and the standalone plan are billed annually only; pay-as-you-go packs are a one-time purchase:
- **Pay-as-you-go (PAYG):** Credit packs that never expire. From $50 for 250,000 credits, with no limit on how many you buy.
- **API add-on:** Add credits to any subscription plan. From $540 per year (effective $45 per month) for 3 million credits.
- **API standalone plan:** Access SE Ranking datasets without the web application. From $2,148 per year for 12 million credits.

The Project API is available on every current subscription plan: Essential, Pro, Business, Core, Growth, and Enterprise. There is nothing extra to buy. Your Project API usage draws on the limits already included in your plan, such as the number of projects, tracked keywords, and audits.

If you have high-volume data needs exceeding standard plans or require a custom API solution, contact our team to discuss enterprise options, custom rate limiting, and pricing. You can reach us at [[email protected]](https://seranking.com/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#ed8c9d84ad9e889f8c838684838ac38e8280).

title: SE Ranking API Comparison: Project API vs. Data API
snippet:
The API package is available as a standalone product — no active SE Ranking subscription is required. Start with a 14-day trial that includes **100,000 free API credits**.
Paid plans include monthly Data API credits for testing: **Core** (25,000/month), **Growth & Enterprise** (100,000/month).
**Legacy v7 plans:** Essential (10,000/month), Pro (25,000/month), Business & Enterprise (100,000/month).
*Legacy v1-v6: Essential and Pro plans do not include API access. To use the API, please purchase the API add-on.*

| | Project API | Data API |
|---|---|---|
| **Primary purpose** | Automate and manage SEO projects | Access SEO datasets and analytics |
| **Best suited for** | Agencies, businesses, and teams managing SEO workflows | Agencies, businesses, developers, and data teams building custom solutions |
| **Billing model** | Uses your SE Ranking subscription limits | Credit-based usage model |
| **API keys** | Shared API key | Shared API key |
| **Available on** | Any paid SE Ranking plan | Any paid SE Ranking plan, which includes a limited number of free API requests (see the disclaimer for details), or an API add-on or standalone API plan for higher API usage. |

| Plan | Included credits |
|---|---|
| Trial | 100,000 credits |
| Core plan | 25,000 credits |
| Growth plan | 100,000 credits |
| API Add-on | From 3M credits/year |
| Standalone API plan | From 12M credits/year |

#### **Billing**
Billing
| Project API | Data API |
|---|---|
| Uses subscription limits | Uses API credits |
| Connected to plan quotas | Scales independently from subscription usage |
| No separate credit balance required | Credits deducted per successful request |
